description: European public procurement: government contracts and tender award notices won by a French company, from official TED data: buyer, country, subject, notice-level amount, CPV codes, official links, co-winners proven legal persons (other names and IDs counted by reason, never named). Identifier-matched only (SIREN/SIRET incl. spaced variants); coverage is eForms notices since 2023-10-25 above EU thresholds, and ~57% of award notices carry a usable identifier, so an empty list is not proof of absence. Complements get_french_company_public_procurement (French DECP, below-threshold). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_eu_procurement_awards

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: EU procurement awards (TED)
